say:1:1222506002:0.text: Why does he look so sad? Let's go talk to him.
say:1:1222506002:0.source_cn: 他怎么满面愁容？我们去看看吧。

say:3:1222507001:0.text: Sinbad! We haven't seen you in ages! What have you been up to?
say:3:1222507001:0.source_cn: 辛巴达，好久没见到你了！最近在忙什么呢？

say:4:1222507002:0.text: Oh, Chippy! Hammie! And hello to you, Magister!
say:4:1222507002:0.male: Oh, Chippy! Hammie! And hello to you, Magister!
say:4:1222507002:0.female: Oh, Chippy! Hammie! And hello to you, Magister!

say:5:1222507003:0.text: Hugin and I, and of course, with the help of the Whispers, have been busy repairing the Chainkeeper.
say:5:1222507003:0.source_cn: 我和呼金，还有血薇帮的兄弟，一直忙着修理枷锁号。

say:7:1222507004:0.text: She's definitely a beauty, but she was badly damaged in her fight with the Immortal. Her deck is a mess. Luckily, her keel is largely undamaged.
say:7:1222507004:0.source_cn: 可怜的美人儿，她在和不死号的海战中伤得不轻，甲板已经破...

say:8:1222507005:0.text: Oh, speaking of luck, Sonja and the Whispers are covering the cost of repairs. Thank goodness, because otherwise, I don't know how many years it would take to make the Chainkeeper seaworthy again.
say:8:1222507005:0.source_cn: 还好索尼娅够大方，大手一挥，说修理费用包在血薇帮身上。...

choice_prompt:9:1222507005.text: Oh, speaking of luck, Sonja and the Whispers are covering the cost of repairs. Thank goodness, because otherwise, I don't know how many years it would take to make the Chainkeeper seaworthy again.
choice_prompt:9:1222507005.source_cn: 幸好索尼娅够大方，大手一挥，说修理费用包在血薇帮身上。不然你们再看到枷锁号下水，不知道要多少年后了。

say:10:1222507006:1.text: Well, it's an investment. The Chainkeeper is not just any old ship. It's one of a kind. Everyone's got their eyes on her.
say:10:1222507006:1.source_cn: 也可能是一种投资。枷锁号是一艘好船——极好的船！多少双...

say:11:1222507007:1.text: Whoever pays for her, I guess. I did think about just stealing the ship or using my irresistible charm to convince Sonja that the Chainkeeper was better off with me.
say:11:1222507007:1.source_cn: 谁出钱算谁的。我倒是盘算过有没有可能劫船，或者靠这副口...

say:12:1222507008:1.text: Even though I have a great relationship with the Whispers, it was out of the question.
say:12:1222507008:1.source_cn: 你看，我和他们交情也算不错……结论是门都没有！

choice:9:1:2.text: Who does the Chainkeeper belong to?
choice:9:1:2.male: Who does the Chainkeeper belong to?
choice:9:1:2.female: Who does the Chainkeeper belong to?

say:13:1222507009:1.text: Well, remember there was a bit of trouble in the city? Sonja's been on edge ever since.
say:13:1222507009:1.source_cn: 之前城里不是出过乱子吗，索尼娅一直没放松警惕。

say:14:1222507010:1.text: I heard she ordered the Whispers to search for any survivors among the Dead Tide Fleet along the coast.
say:14:1222507010:1.source_cn: 听说她下令，在让血薇帮沿岸搜查死潮舰队幸存者的踪影。

choice_prompt:15:1222507010.text: I heard she ordered the Whispers to search for any survivors among the Dead Tide Fleet along the coast.
choice_prompt:15:1222507010.source_cn: 听说她下令，在让血薇帮沿岸搜查死潮舰队幸存者的踪影。

say:17:1222507013:0.text: I think she just wants to prevent trouble in the future and also to put her mind at ease.
say:17:1222507013:0.source_cn: 我想，这是为了杜绝后患，也是为索尼娅自己的执念划上句号吧。

say:20:1222507014:0.text: By the way, Magister, I need your help with something.
say:20:1222507014:0.male: By the way, Magister, I need your help with something.
say:20:1222507014:0.female: By the way, Magister, I need your help with something.

say:21:1222507015:1.source_cn: 你们最近有没有<style=highlight>做噩梦...

say:22:1222507016:1.text: I haven't been sleeping well lately. It feels like I've been dreaming about something important, but...
say:22:1222507016:1.source_cn: 这几天我一直睡不好，总感觉梦里有大事发生。

say:23:1222507017:1.text: ...as soon as I wake up, I don't remember anything. This keeps happening over and over again. I haven't had a good night's sleep in a while.
say:23:1222507017:1.source_cn: 但一睁眼，又什么都不记得了……就这么反反复复，每天都休...

say:24:1222507018:1.text: I asked Hugin if he had trouble sleeping, but the man could sleep through a storm, and he snores louder than thunder.
say:24:1222507018:1.source_cn: 问过呼金那家伙，他倒是睡得香甜，鼾声比汽笛都响！

say:25:1222507019:1.text: Do you know a way for someone to get a good night's sleep? Whether it be magic or through other means...
say:25:1222507019:1.source_cn: 你们有没有能让人好好睡上一觉的办法？不管是魔法，还是别...

choice_prompt:26:1222507019.text: Do you know a way for someone to get a good night's sleep? Whether it be magic or through other means...
choice_prompt:26:1222507019.source_cn: 你们有没有能让人好好睡上一觉的办法？不管是魔法，还是别的招数……

say:27:1222507021:1.text: Well, I do remember the recipe to a <style="highlight">calming elixir</style>.

say:28:1222507022:1.text: Yes, a potion will do. I haven't had a magical potion before. This will be my first time!
say:28:1222507022:1.source_cn: 药剂就成，药剂就成。想想我还没喝过魔药呢，这是第一次！

say:29:1222507023:0.text: The fate of my peaceful nights is in your hands, my friends.
say:29:1222507023:0.source_cn: 那我的睡眠质量就拜托你们了，朋友。

say:33:1222507024:0.source_cn: 噩梦……满满不记得自己做过噩梦。

say:34:1222507025:0.text: Neither do I. Perhaps Sinbad's been working too hard on the Chainkeeper.
say:34:1222507025:0.source_cn: 我也没有。是辛巴达为了修枷锁号，太过劳累吧？

choice_prompt:35:1222507025.text: Neither do I. Perhaps Sinbad's been working too hard on the Chainkeeper.
choice_prompt:35:1222507025.source_cn: 我也没有。是辛巴达为了修枷锁号，太过劳累吧？

say:36:1222507026:1.text: We'll need three ingredients from an apothecary or a potion shop to make the calming elixir. I know where to go!
say:36:1222507026:1.source_cn: 做安神药剂需要三种素材。我们去药剂店买原料吧！

choice:35:0:1.text: How do you make a calming elixir?
choice:35:0:1.source_cn: 安神药剂要怎么做来着？
choice:35:0:1.male: How do you make a calming elixir?
choice:35:0:1.female: How do you make a calming elixir?

say:38:1222507020:1.text: Alright, forget it. I've experienced that many a time. It's an easy way to fall asleep and not wake up.
say:38:1222507020:1.male: Alright, forget it. I've experienced that many a time. It's an easy way to fall asleep and not wake up.
say:38:1222507020:1.female: Alright, forget it. I've experienced that many a time. It's an easy way to fall asleep and not wake up.

choice:26:1:2.text: A bonk on the head, maybe...?
choice:26:1:2.source_cn: 比如说，给头上来一棍子……？
choice:26:1:2.male: A bonk on the head, maybe...?
choice:26:1:2.female: A bonk on the head, maybe...?

say:39:1222507011:1.text: You're a smart fella. I was thinking the same thing. She's got a lot of reasons for finding her.
say:39:1222507011:1.male: You're a smart fella. I was thinking the same thing. She's got a lot of reasons for finding her.
say:39:1222507011:1.female: You're a smart lady. I was thinking the same thing. She's got a lot of reasons for finding her.

choice:15:1:2.text: She's looking for Nara, isn't she?
choice:15:1:2.source_cn: 她是不是还想找奈拉的下落？
choice:15:1:2.male: She's looking for Nara, isn't she?
choice:15:1:2.female: She's looking for Nara, isn't she?

choice:9:2:3.text: Anything new with the Whispers lately?
choice:9:2:3.male: Anything new with the Whispers lately?
choice:9:2:3.female: Anything new with the Whispers lately?

say:2:1222508001:1.text: Hello, my dear merchant. We need ingredients for a calming elixir. Do you have anything available that can help us?
say:2:1222508001:1.source_cn: 商人先生，我们要买安神药剂所需的材料，你这里有吗？

say:3:1222508002:1.text: Oh, I remember you lot. You're those apothecaries that somehow ended up here.
say:3:1222508002:1.source_cn: 哦……我记得你们，从港口外来的药剂师！

choice_prompt:4:1222508002.text: Oh, I remember you lot. You're those apothecaries that somehow ended up here.
choice_prompt:4:1222508002.source_cn: 哦……我记得你们，从港口外来的药剂师！

say:5:1222508003:1.source_cn: 对，对，魔法师！我想起来了。

say:6:1222508004:1.text: Sinbad brought you to my shop and wrangled a bunch of my alchemy supplies right from under me. I remember that very clearly.
say:6:1222508004:1.source_cn: 当初辛巴达那小子带着你们，捞走了不少炼金材料，我记得清...

say:7:1222508007:1.text: Anyway, you said you wanted ingredients for a calming elixir, right? I just had a shipment come in, but I haven't taken inventory yet. Everything's piled up over there.
say:7:1222508007:1.source_cn: 好了，是要安神药剂的材料对吧……我刚进了货，还没清点，...

say:8:1222508008:1.text: Also... since you arrived in Rustport, things have been going well, and now the port's back up... You know what? Free of charge this time! But you have to <style="highlight">find the ingredients yourself</style>.
say:8:1222508008:1.source_cn: 你们是我的幸运星，你们一来，锈锚港就开放了。这次我不收...

say:10:1222508005:1.text: The port's reopened. All the trade ships are back, and people still need potions and supplies.
say:10:1222508005:1.source_cn: 港口重新开放，有货船出航，药剂和炼金材料的生意又好起来了。

say:11:1222508006:1.text: In the end, I know what I'm good at, and it's this.
say:11:1222508006:1.source_cn: 看来看去，我还是擅长干这行。

choice:4:1:2.text: I thought you were closing up shop?
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 记得你说过以后不卖炼金材料了？
choice:4:1:2.male: I thought you were closing up shop?
choice:4:1:2.female: I thought you were closing up shop?

say:0:1222509001:0.text: Okay, now that we have everything. Let's start making this elixir.
say:0:1222509001:0.source_cn: 这样材料就收集齐了，我们可以开始炼制药剂了。
say:0:1222509001:0.male: Okay, now that we have everything. Let's start making this elixir.
say:0:1222509001:0.female: Okay, now that we have everything. Let's start making this elixir.

say:0:1222510001:0.text: Sinbad will definitely have a good night's sleep after drinking this!
say:0:1222510001:0.source_cn: 辛巴达这次能做个好梦了！

say:3:1222511001:1.text: Sinbad! We're back! We have the calming elixir for you!
say:3:1222511001:1.source_cn: 辛巴达，我们回来啦！安神药剂做好了！

say:4:1222511002:1.text: Drink it before going to bed. If you drink it during the day, you'll feel super tired and sleepy. Other side effects may occur.
say:4:1222511002:1.source_cn: 记得在睡前喝。要是白天饮用，反而会精神不振哦。

say:5:1222511003:1.text: Wow! We were so busy saving Chippy last time, I didn't get a chance to look at the potion. This one looks beautiful!
say:5:1222511003:1.source_cn: 哇……之前忙着救人，没工夫认真瞧。仔细看看，炼金术做出...

say:6:1222511004:0.text: Hmm... hypothetically, if you were to sell something like this, how much do you think it'll go for?
say:6:1222511004:0.source_cn: 我说……这东西能卖多少钱？

choice_prompt:9:1222511004.text: Hmm... hypothetically, if you were to sell something like this, how much do you think it'll go for?
choice_prompt:9:1222511004.source_cn: 我说……这东西能卖多少钱？

say:10:1222511005:1.text: So just labor costs? How much is it to hire a mage?
say:10:1222511005:1.source_cn: 所以只要付人工费？不过雇佣魔法师又得花多少……

say:11:1222511006:1.text: Never mind, I don't think we can make a lot with this.
say:11:1222511006:1.source_cn: 还是算了，这路数好像捞不到钱。

say:12:1222511011:1.text: Anyway, thanks to you, I'll finally be able to get a good night's sleep.
say:12:1222511011:1.male: Anyway, thanks to you, I'll finally be able to get a good night's sleep.
say:12:1222511011:1.female: Anyway, thanks to you, I'll finally be able to get a good night's sleep.

say:13:1222511012:1.text: You should rest up as well. I've heard you've been running around helping people in the city. Remember to take a break when you can. Look at Chippy. He's starting to look like a ferret with all the weight he lost.
say:13:1222511012:1.source_cn: 你们也悠着点，别整天在城里忙上忙下，该休息就休息。瞧瞧...

say:14:1222511013:0.text: Alright, I got work to do, so I'll see you later.
say:14:1222511013:0.source_cn: 那么——我还有活要干，先走了。回见！

say:18:1222511014:0.text: Hammie, Sinbad said Chippy lost some weight. Is it true?
say:18:1222511014:0.source_cn: 漫漫，你听到了吗，辛巴达说我瘦了！

say:19:1222511015:0.text: Let me see... does your belt feel looser?
say:19:1222511015:0.source_cn: 有吗？让我看看……有觉得腰带变松吗？

say:21:1222511017:1.text: Does your helmet feel like it's sliding off?
say:21:1222511017:1.source_cn: 那，有觉得头盔往下滑吗？

say:24:1222511019:0.text: But Chippy does feel like something has changed! Chippy's sword strikes aren't as fast and powerful as before...
say:24:1222511019:0.source_cn: 但满满真的觉得自己有变化！挥剑没有之前迅捷，力量好像也...

say:25:1222511020:1.text: Perhaps Sinbad is right. We have been really busy these past couple of days.
say:25:1222511020:1.source_cn: 唔……也许辛巴达说得对，我们这段时间确实很忙。

say:26:1222511021:1.source_cn: 先是击溃了死潮舰队，又帮助了锈锚港里的帮派。不光如此，...

say:28:1222511022:0.source_cn: 主人，满满觉得你该放松一下了……
say:28:1222511022:0.male: Magister, maybe it's time for you to take a break...
say:28:1222511022:0.female: Magister, maybe it's time for you to take a break...

say:29:1222511023:1.text: Chippy's right, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. How about we go to the <style="highlight">Golden Guest Inn</style> and spend <style="highlight">tonight</style> in one of their VIP rooms?
say:29:1222511023:1.male: Chippy's right, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. How about we go to the <style="highlight">Golden Guest Inn</style> and spend <style="highlight">tonight</style> in one of their VIP rooms?

say:30:1222511024:1.text: I'm sure the Whispers still have a reservation for us under your name.
say:30:1222511024:1.source_cn: 血薇帮应该还帮我们留着房间。

choice_prompt:32:1222511024.source_cn: 血薇帮应该还帮我们留着房间。

say:33:1222511025:1.text: Alright, let's not worry about anything today and make it as relaxing as possible!
say:33:1222511025:1.source_cn: 嗯，那我们今天就什么都不要管，轻松惬意地度过一天吧！

choice:32:0:1.text: We should take advantage while we can.
choice:32:0:1.source_cn: 有便宜可占，为什么不呢？

say:0:1222523001:1.text: Look! There's a group of glimmerblooms over there!

say:6:1222525004:1.source_cn: 不——不可以去！会被吃掉！一口！全吃掉！

say:10:1222531006:0.text: How can this be? The magister and the sword bearer are both here! They should be able to defeat the Hypogean!

say:11:1222531007:0.source_cn: 啊，我知道了。是不是因为辛巴达不够强？

choice_prompt:12:1222531007.source_cn: 啊，我知道了。是不是因为辛巴达不够强？

say:13:1222531008:1.text: I'm better at escaping than fighting. That's the truth.
say:13:1222531008:1.source_cn: 比起打架，我更擅长逃跑！

say:14:1222531009:0.text: I mean this compass belongs to Tritonus. He's the god of the waves and wandering. This was made for escaping.

say:16:1222531011:1.text: There has to be another way!

say:21:1222531012:0.text: Found you! My soft, round, delicious meal!

choice:12:0:1.text: No need to be so blunt.
choice:12:0:1.male: No need to be so blunt.
choice:12:0:1.female: No need to be so blunt.

say:4:1222534002:0.text: But Grandpa Ulmus is still in the nightmare... What happened? Did you not finish off the Hypogean?
say:4:1222534002:0.source_cn: 但是，奥曼斯爷爷还在梦魇中……怎么回事，难道恶魔的影响...

choice_prompt:5:1222534002.text: But Grandpa Ulmus is still in the nightmare... What happened? Did you not finish off the Hypogean?
choice_prompt:5:1222534002.source_cn: 但是，奥曼斯爷爷还在梦魇中……怎么回事，难道恶魔的影响还没有被消除？

say:8:1222534005:0.text: But heroes always defeat the bad guys! Otherwise, stories and legends wouldn't be written and sung about...
say:8:1222534005:0.source_cn: 但是，英雄必须要打败坏人才行呀！否则故事书写不下去，史...

say:9:1222534006:0.text: That Hypogean is going to eat this island like a chocolate chip cookie, and after he's done, he's going to devour Ulmus' mind! I refuse to lose my friend!
say:9:1222534006:0.source_cn: 那个恶魔会像吃小曲奇一样吃掉藏梦岛，然后吞噬奥曼斯的意...

say:12:1222534007:0.text: I'm so sorry, Tasi. We've never fought such a strong enemy before.
say:12:1222534007:0.source_cn: 对不起，塔西，我们也没见过这么强韧的恶魔！

say:13:1222534008:0.text: That thing is like a bloodthirsty shark. The more we hurt him, the harder he fights.
say:13:1222534008:0.source_cn: 那家伙简直是条彻头彻尾的嗜血鲨鱼，伤口越多，战意就越高昂。

say:14:1222534009:1.text: Wait a minute. Where's your compass, Sinbad? Did it not come in handy?
say:14:1222534009:1.source_cn: 等一下等一下，辛巴达，你的罗盘呢？没派上用场吗？

say:17:1222534010:1.text: We used it to escape. So far, it just points in a direction and shows the way.
say:17:1222534010:1.source_cn: ——用来逃跑了！到现在为止，它除了指方向，也就这一个作用！

say:18:1222534011:1.text: *Sigh* In that thing's eyes, we're all just fresh meat. Even Merlin's on his menu...

say:18:1222534011:1.male: *Sigh* In that thing's eyes, we're all just fresh meat. Even Merlin's on his menu...
say:18:1222534011:1.female: *Sigh* In that thing's eyes, we're all just fresh meat. Even Merlin's on his menu...

say:19:1222534012:1.text: Strategically, it was better for us to retreat, or else he would've eaten us.
say:19:1222534012:1.source_cn: 比起被他一口吞了，还是先战术撤退，保存有生力量更明智吧！

say:22:1222534013:0.text: Yes, but running away isn't what a knight should do!
say:22:1222534013:0.source_cn: 但是，临阵脱逃，不是骑士的作风！

say:23:1222534014:0.text: I agree with Sinbad. Even Magister Merlin was in danger when facing this Hypogean.
say:23:1222534014:0.source_cn: 我同意辛巴达的看法，面对恶魔，就算是梅林也很危险。
say:23:1222534014:0.male: I agree with Sinbad. Even Magister Merlin was in danger when facing this Hypogean.
say:23:1222534014:0.female: I agree with Sinbad. Even Magister Merlin was in danger when facing this Hypogean.

say:25:1222534015:1.text: Alright, let's stop arguing! In the dream that Ulmus and I have woven, no one is allowed to argue!
say:25:1222534015:1.source_cn: 唔唔唔……不要吵！在我和奥曼斯爷爷一起编织的梦境里，谁...

say:26:1222534016:1.text: But what can we do now? All I knew was that the sword bearer and Merlin were needed to seal the Hypogean. No one said that they would fail!

say:26:1222534016:1.female: But what can we do now? All I knew was that the sword bearer and Merlin were needed to seal the Hypogean. No one said that they would fail!

say:30:1222534017:0.text: It doesn't do us any good to stand around and chat all day. Ulmus needs us right now.
say:30:1222534017:0.source_cn: 我说，就这么干站着聊不是事，奥曼斯眼看着情况不好。

say:31:1222534018:1.text: They say there's strength in numbers. If we can't handle this by ourselves, let's <style="highlight">call for help</style>.
say:31:1222534018:1.source_cn: 都说人多力量大，如果靠我们几个搞不定，<style=h...

say:32:1222534019:0.text: Why don't we go back, find Sonja, and come up with a plan?
say:32:1222534019:0.source_cn: 回去找索尼娅他们想想办法？

say:33:1222534020:0.text: Yes, that can be an option. We can't just let the Hypogean destroy the Dream Isle.
say:33:1222534020:0.source_cn: ……也只能这么办了，不能放任恶魔在藏梦岛破坏。

say:36:1222534021:0.text: We can also look for other people to help us. Rustport's so big. There has to be someone who's heard of this thing.
say:36:1222534021:0.source_cn: 也许还能找到对付他的方法。锈锚港那么大，总该有人听说过...

say:37:1222534022:1.text: Then it's settled. Our defeat today will spawn a great victory upon our return.
say:37:1222534022:1.source_cn: 那就这么定了。现在的撤退是为了更伟大的胜利。

say:38:1222534023:1.text: Wait for us, Tasi. We'll come back with help.
say:38:1222534023:1.source_cn: 等着吧，塔西，我们会带着帮手回来！

choice:27:0:1.text: I had no time to seal him.
choice:27:0:1.male: I had no time to seal him.
choice:27:0:1.female: I had no time to seal him.

say:40:1222534003:0.text: Ummm... yeah, we couldn't beat him.
say:40:1222534003:0.source_cn: 呃……直白地说，我们打不过。

say:0:1222535001:0.text: Sonja should be in her office at the Carmine Whispers headquarters.
say:0:1222535001:0.source_cn: 索尼娅应该在血薇帮话事处，走着。

say:1:1222535002:0.text: Chippy hopes that we can find a way to deal with that ugly shark!
say:1:1222535002:0.source_cn: 希望能找到对付那只大鲨鱼的办法！

say:2:1222536001:1.text: Greetings, tell me what you need.
say:2:1222536001:1.male: Greetings, tell me what you need.
say:2:1222536001:1.female: Greetings, tell me what you need.

choice_prompt:3:1222536001.male: Greetings, tell me what you need.
choice_prompt:3:1222536001.female: Greetings, tell me what you need.

say:4:1222536002:1.source_cn: 能让你亲自来，一定是大事。
say:4:1222536002:1.male: If you're here personally, it must be a big deal.
say:4:1222536002:1.female: If you're here personally, it must be a big deal.

say:5:1222536003:1.text: And don't worry. The Whispers will always help the heroes who freed Rustport, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:5:1222536003:1.male: And don't worry. The Whispers will always help the heroes who freed Rustport, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:5:1222536003:1.female: And don't worry. The Whispers will always help the heroes who freed Rustport, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:6:1222536004:1.text: What about me? I also helped to defeat the Dead Tide Fleet.
say:6:1222536004:1.source_cn: 那我呢？我也帮忙击退了死潮舰队！

say:11:1222536007:1.text: I see.. I dispatched people to look for signs of the Dead Tide Fleet after the Immortal sank. We heard reports of a sudden whirlpool and of fishermen going missing frequently around the Blackthorn Sea.
say:11:1222536007:1.source_cn: ……不死号沉没后，我派人在黑棘海网状搜索死潮舰队的踪迹...

say:12:1222536008:1.text: However, the whirlpool disappeared when we were investigating, and we found nothing unusual nearby, so we turned our attention to the coastline.
say:12:1222536008:1.source_cn: 但那漩涡很快就消失了。附近并无异样。我们也就把目标转向...

say:13:1222536009:1.text: I didn't realize Tasi and Ulmus were secretly protecting us and the Dream Isle...
say:13:1222536009:1.source_cn: 原来是塔西和奥曼斯在暗中保护……

say:14:1222536010:1.text: So you also didn't know that a Hypogean was sealed underneath the Blackthorn Sea.
say:14:1222536010:1.source_cn: 所以你也不知道黑棘海底封印着一个恶魔？

say:17:1222536012:0.text: That can be done. The upper district has a number of closely guarded libraries, as well as private collections of ancient books and scrolls. I'll have people look for this entity.
say:17:1222536012:0.source_cn: 好办。上城区有不少严加看管的图书馆，也有私人收藏的古籍...

say:18:1222536013:0.text: As soon as there's news, I'll send someone to contact you.
say:18:1222536013:0.source_cn: 一有消息，我就派人紧急联络你们。

choice:16:0:1.text: We need intel on this Hypogean.
choice:16:0:1.male: We need intel on this Hypogean.
choice:16:0:1.female: We need intel on this Hypogean.

say:19:1222536014:1.text: No problem. My friends are your friends.
say:19:1222536014:1.source_cn: 不成问题。我的兄弟就是你们的兄弟。

say:20:1222536015:1.text: Wait a minute, this is a Hypogean we're talking about. Just increasing our numbers isn't going to cut it.
say:20:1222536015:1.source_cn: 等等，对手是恶魔，光堆人头不是事。

say:21:1222536016:1.text: With the Dead Tide Fleet gone, aren't your cannons just collecting dust? How about lending us a few?
say:21:1222536016:1.source_cn: 现在死潮舰队没了，你们那么多火炮是不是有落灰的，借我们几架？

say:22:1222536017:0.text: I know those cannons could tear the tentacles off a kraken. Let me fire a volley at that Hyposhark, and I'll have that thing begging for mercy!
say:22:1222536017:0.source_cn: 有能轰断海怪触手的火炮，对准那头鲨鱼恶魔来一轮齐射，我...

say:23:1222536018:0.text: I'll give you my best. Just let me know how many you need.
say:23:1222536018:0.source_cn: 给你们最精良的军火，要多少说个数。

say:24:1222536019:1.text: I'll also let Hugin help you set up. He knows best how to use these cannons.
say:24:1222536019:1.source_cn: 让呼金也协助你们，架设火炮，他最在行。

say:25:1222536020:0.text: If we're gonna fight, be prepared to deliver the killing blow. We cannot give the enemy a chance to escape and regroup.
say:25:1222536020:0.source_cn: 既然要反击，就要一击毙命。不能再给对方喘息的机会。

choice_prompt:27:1222536020.text: If we're gonna fight, be prepared to deliver the killing blow. We cannot give the enemy a chance to escape and regroup.

say:28:1222536021:0.text: I will instruct my men to prepare and load all the equipment you'll need on the ship.
say:28:1222536021:0.source_cn: 不必客气。我这就吩咐弟兄们做好准备，把你们要用的一切装...

say:29:1222536022:1.text: When it's <style="highlight">dusk</style>, you can head over to the <style="highlight">docks</style> to do a final inspection before setting sail.

say:30:1222536023:1.text: I wish you all the best of luck.

choice:27:1:2.text: No wonder you're the leader of the Whispers.
choice:27:1:2.male: No wonder you're the leader of the Whispers.
choice:27:1:2.female: No wonder you're the leader of the Whispers.

choice:16:1:2.text: I want to borrow a few men from the Whispers.
choice:16:1:2.male: I want to borrow a few men from the Whispers.
choice:16:1:2.female: I want to borrow a few men from the Whispers.

choice:3:0:1.text: How did you know we needed help?
choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 你怎么知道我们需要帮助？
choice:3:0:1.male: How did you know we needed help?
choice:3:0:1.female: How did you know we needed help?

say:0:1222537001:0.text: It's time to head to the docks!
say:0:1222537001:0.source_cn: 时间差不多了，我们去码头吧！

say:3:1222539002:1.text: Hahaha! If it isn't my good friends! Come give me a hug!
say:3:1222539002:1.source_cn: 嚯哈哈哈哈！不愧是我的朋友，让我给你们一个拥抱！

say:4:1222539003:1.text: Hold it right there. What's going on?
say:4:1222539003:1.source_cn: 慢着慢着，好端端的，怎么回事？

say:5:1222539004:1.text: Sonja has informed me that I'll be taking my bombastic babies to battle a Hypogean.
say:5:1222539004:1.source_cn: 索尼娅告诉我了，让我带这些精心打造的孩子去和恶魔打一场。

say:6:1222539005:0.text: After the fight against the Dead Tide Fleet, they've been clamoring to show off their capabilities, but there wasn't a chance to do so.
say:6:1222539005:0.source_cn: 和死潮舰队决战之后，他们闹着要再展示展示身手，可根本没...

say:7:1222539006:0.text: And then this opportunity falls from the sky! A chance to test my cannons against a demonic entity! Whoever thought of this is a pure genius!
say:7:1222539006:0.source_cn: 谁能想到，用恶魔试炮的机会竟然从天而降！不管是谁提出的...

choice_prompt:8:1222539006.text: And then this opportunity falls from the sky! A chance to test my cannons against a demonic entity! Whoever thought of this is a pure genius!
choice_prompt:8:1222539006.source_cn: 谁能想到，用恶魔试炮的机会竟然从天而降！不管是谁提出的想法，那个人真是天才！

say:9:1222539009:0.text: How are the preparations going? I see that everything is almost loaded.
say:9:1222539009:0.source_cn: 东西准备得怎么样？我看已经在装船了？

say:10:1222539010:1.text: The cannons and gunpowder have been stowed. We just need to load a few more crates of ammunition, and we're ready to go!
say:10:1222539010:1.source_cn: 火炮都就位了，还差几箱弹药。

say:11:1222539011:0.text: These fellas from the Whispers need more pep in their step!
say:11:1222539011:0.source_cn: 这几个血薇帮的小兄弟，手脚不麻利！

say:14:1222539012:0.text: You're the one who said to be careful with the gunpowder!

say:15:1222539013:0.text: Of course, you need to be careful! If you accidentally knock over the gunpowder and there's a spark around, the whole thing will explode!
say:15:1222539013:0.source_cn: 当然要小心！火药引信有可能受潮，你们要是毛手毛脚的磕了...

say:16:1222539014:1.text: And down goes this ship with everything and everyone inside!
say:16:1222539014:1.source_cn: 那这一船的好宝贝就都要葬身水底了！

say:17:1222539015:1.text: Well, you can't have it both ways!

say:21:1222539016:0.text: Hey, why don't we help out as well? Let's have everything loaded so we can go to the Dream Isle and deal with that hideous Hypogean!
say:21:1222539016:0.source_cn: 我们也来帮忙吧，赶快收拾妥当，就可以去对付藏梦岛的恶魔了！

say:24:1222539017:1.text: Yes, just leave the rest to us! We need to hurry and help Ulmus!
say:24:1222539017:1.source_cn: 是呀，奥曼斯的状况不能久等，剩下的就交给我们吧！

say:26:1222539007:0.text: Really? I guess I have to stay longer in Rustport now and install a ventilation system for her office as thanks.
say:26:1222539007:0.source_cn: 真的？那我就多留一阵，给她改造改造话事处通风系统吧。

say:27:1222539008:0.text: I also wanna thank you for bringing us this Hypogean! Hahaha!
say:27:1222539008:0.source_cn: 说来说去，也得感谢你们带来了恶魔的消息！嚯哈哈哈！

choice:8:1:2.text: I am a genius, aren't I?
choice:8:1:2.male: I am a genius, aren't I?
choice:8:1:2.female: I am a genius, aren't I?

say:1:1222540002:0.text: Bring up the anchor! Let's set sail!
say:1:1222540002:0.male: Bring up the anchor! Let's set sail!
say:1:1222540002:0.female: Bring up the anchor! Let's set sail!

say:3:1222541001:1.text: Tasi! We're back, and we've brought help!
say:3:1222541001:1.source_cn: 塔西，我们叫帮手回来了！

say:4:1222541002:1.text: Hahaha! Show me where this Hypogean is!
say:4:1222541002:1.source_cn: 嚯嚯嚯，让我看看，用来当靶子的恶魔在哪呢？

say:5:1222541003:1.text: Don't tell me it's this little thing. Sonja told me the monster looked like a shark, not some pretty butterfly.
say:5:1222541003:1.source_cn: ……是这个？索尼娅说那恶魔像鲨鱼，但这个明显是蝴蝶。还...

say:8:1222541005:1.text: He's rash, rough, and rude! Do I look like a monster?! I'm the fairy that guards your dreams!
say:8:1222541005:1.source_cn: 粗野，鲁莽，没礼貌！我哪里像恶魔？我是守护梦境的妖精！

say:9:1222541006:0.text: Everything on the Dream Isle, including the ground you're standing on, was created by me! How can you confuse me with that horrendous Hypogean?!
say:9:1222541006:0.source_cn: 你脚下站的地面，还有整个闪闪发光的藏梦岛，都是我编织的...

say:11:1222541007:1.text: A fairy? Fairies are extremely rare in Esperia! I've heard that fairy dust is highly prized for its light and magical attributes. Even the imperial smiths at the royal capital have little in stock.
say:11:1222541007:1.source_cn: 妖精？妖精也稀奇！我听说妖精洒下的粉末是轻盈又含魔力的...

say:12:1222541008:0.text: After we deal with the Hypogean, can you share a bit of your fairy dust with me?
say:12:1222541008:0.source_cn: 等处理完恶魔的需求，分点材料让我试试呗？

say:13:1222541009:0.text: Get away from me! How dare you try to steal my fairy dust?!
say:13:1222541009:0.source_cn: ——不要靠近我！竟然还想取我翅膀上的磷粉，真是太野蛮了！

say:14:1222541010:0.text: Don't worry, child. Once you see how my cannons will obliterate that monster, you'll change your mind about hardworking dwarves like myself.
say:14:1222541010:0.source_cn: 孩子，等用呼金炮把那个恶魔轰飞，你就会对勤勉踏实的矮人...

say:15:1222541011:0.text: Child?! You're clearly shorter than I am! Plus, I'm much older than you!
say:15:1222541011:0.source_cn: 孩子？！你明明比我还矮！而且我岁数比你大！大很多很多！

choice_prompt:16:1222541011.text: Child?! You're clearly shorter than I am! Plus, I'm much older than you!
choice_prompt:16:1222541011.source_cn: 孩子？！你明明比我还矮！而且我岁数比你大！大很多很多！

say:21:1222541012:0.text: Alright, alright... Remember, we're here to deal with the Hypogean.
say:21:1222541012:0.source_cn: 好了好了，别忘了，我们是来对付恶魔的！

say:22:1222541013:0.text: Although you two started off on the wrong foot, I can guarantee that Hugin's skills are the real deal.
say:22:1222541013:0.source_cn: 虽然初次会面不太愉快，但我可以担保，呼金的技艺绝对值得信赖。

say:23:1222541014:1.text: He's our best shot at defeating this Hyposhark.
say:23:1222541014:1.source_cn: 他是我们击败鲨鱼恶魔最好的助力！

say:25:1222541016:0.text: Since you brought him, I will reluctantly allow him and his mechanical doodads to enter my dream realm.
say:25:1222541016:0.source_cn: 既然是你们带来的人，我就勉为其难地准许他和他的机械造物...

say:26:1222541017:0.text: Ha! That took longer than I expected. So, where's the target? Shorty and Hardhead are roaring to go!
say:26:1222541017:0.source_cn: 嚯嚯，耽误了不少时间。真正的靶子在哪里，铁头和矮地他们...

say:27:1222541018:1.text: Let's take a look at the compass.

say:31:1222541019:0.text: Based on the direction it's pointing, he's still at <style="highlight">Wind's Point</style>.
say:31:1222541019:0.source_cn: 这个方位……看起来他还在<style=highligh...

say:33:1222541020:0.text: Then let's go! It's time to show that Hypogean what we're made of!
say:33:1222541020:0.source_cn: 嚯哈哈哈，走！让那个恶魔瞧瞧我们的厉害！

say:39:1222541022:0.text: He's definitely more fired up than usual.

say:40:1222541023:1.text: Let's quickly get to that monster. If Hugin gets antsy and starts testing his cannons on other things on the island, then Ulmus is cooked.
say:40:1222541023:1.source_cn: 咱们也快跟上，要是呼金一时兴起用岛上其他东西试炮，奥曼...

say:45:1222541024:0.text: Just be careful, and don't underestimate the enemy!
say:45:1222541024:0.source_cn: 喂——你们大家都小心呀！别轻敌！

say:46:1222541025:0.text: I really hope you all return safely...
say:46:1222541025:0.source_cn: 真是的……希望他们能平安归来。

say:48:1222541026:0.text: Oh, Grandpa Ulmus! How are you feeling? I'll try my best to fill your dreams with all the happiest things in the world.
say:48:1222541026:0.source_cn: 奥曼斯爷爷，你感觉怎么样？我会尽力用世界上所有好玩的东...

say:49:1222541027:0.text: Don't you dare lose to that monster! You can't let him devour your mind!
say:49:1222541027:0.source_cn: 不要输给那个讨厌的恶魔，不要被他吞噬意识！

choice:16:0:1.text: We're going to use Hugin's cannons.
choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 我们准备用呼金的炮对付恶魔
choice:16:0:1.male: We're going to use Hugin's cannons.
choice:16:0:1.female: We're going to use Hugin's cannons.

say:1:1222542002:0.text: I'm here! The target is toward the west!

say:0:1222550001:0.text: Don't be too hard on yourself. Eat something and rest.
say:0:1222550001:0.source_cn: 别委屈自己，先吃点东西休息一下吧。

say:3:1222554001:0.text: Lucca, you actually came in person!

say:4:1222554002:1.text: Do the Whispers have any leads on the Hyposhark?
say:4:1222554002:1.source_cn: 血薇帮查到鲨鱼恶魔的线索了吗？

say:7:1222554004:0.text: According to a few ancient tomes we found in the upper district, a primordial Hypogean named <style="highlight">Harak</style> was sealed beneath the Blackthorn Sea.
say:7:1222554004:0.source_cn: 上城区大图书馆古籍里的记载：古时名为<style=hi...

say:8:1222554005:0.text: We even discovered a phrase written by the author near Harak's name.
say:8:1222554005:0.source_cn: 除此之外，卷宗上还有其他内容。我们发现撰书人在哈拉克的...

say:12:1222554007:0.text: Could it be that his instincts are so powerful that they overrule his reasoning?
say:12:1222554007:0.source_cn: 难道说，他的本能过于强大，以至于压倒了理性？

say:13:1222554008:1.text: He surrendered his ability to communicate and think, leaving only the most primal, beast-like urge to devour... that's why he's so strong!
say:13:1222554008:1.source_cn: 牺牲了交流和思考的能力，只留下最原始最兽性的进食冲动…...

say:16:1222554009:0.text: In other words, he's not the brightest, is he?
say:16:1222554009:0.source_cn: 换个说法，也就是他脑子不太聪明？

say:19:1222554011:1.text: Thanks, Lucca! Tell Sonja we're in her debt.
say:19:1222554011:1.source_cn: 谢了，卢卡！回索尼娅一声，我们欠她个人情。

say:22:1222554013:0.text: One more thing, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I have a message from Sonja.
say:22:1222554013:0.male: One more thing, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I have a message from Sonja.
say:22:1222554013:0.female: One more thing, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I have a message from Sonja.

say:23:1222554014:0.text: She's confident you'll win, no matter who it is you're up against.

choice_prompt:24:1222554014.source_cn: 她相信无论对手是谁，你会赢。

say:29:1222554017:1.text: Sinbad, have you thought of a plan to deal with Harak?
say:29:1222554017:1.source_cn: 辛巴达，你想出应对哈拉克的计策了？

say:31:1222554019:1.text: Since we've chosen to outwit him, with our group and Tasi's dream-altering ability, we'll definitely figure something out.
say:31:1222554019:1.source_cn: 但既然决定要智取，靠我们几个，再加上塔西塑造梦境的力量...

say:32:1222554020:1.text: Yes, we'll have to brief her on the intel.
say:32:1222554020:1.source_cn: 嗯……也得把情报告诉她才行。

say:33:1222554021:1.text: Let's go, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. We need to <style="highlight">return to Tasi and formulate a plan</style>.
say:33:1222554021:1.male: Let's go, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. We need to <style="highlight">return to Tasi and formulate a plan</style>.
say:33:1222554021:1.female: Let's go, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. We need to <style="highlight">return to Tasi and formulate a plan</style>.

say:34:1222554022:1.text: This time, we must defeat Harak!
say:34:1222554022:1.source_cn: 这次一定要打败哈拉克！

choice:24:2:3.male: If I lose again, I'll lose it.
choice:24:2:3.female: If I lose again, I'll lose it.

say:5:1222555003:0.source_cn: 咦？诶？你们之前不是带着矮人和火炮去找他了吗？

say:6:1222555004:0.text: You were gone for so long this time! What happened?
say:6:1222555004:0.source_cn: 而且你们这次去得好久啊！发生什么了？

choice_prompt:9:1222555004.text: You were gone for so long this time! What happened?
choice_prompt:9:1222555004.source_cn: 而且你们这次去得好久啊！发生什么了？

say:10:1222555005:0.text: I'm not dreaming, right?! You actually lost twice?! The great Merlin and the sword bearer lost again?!
say:10:1222555005:0.source_cn: 我、不是、在、做梦吧！你们竟然会连输两次？！梅林和持剑...
say:10:1222555005:0.male: I'm not dreaming, right?! You actually lost twice?! The great Merlin and the sword bearer lost again?!
say:10:1222555005:0.female: I'm not dreaming, right?! You actually lost twice?! The great Merlin and the sword bearer lost again?!

say:11:1222555006:0.text: But we did make some progress. We finally learned where that Hypogean came from!
say:11:1222555006:0.source_cn: 但是，我们也有一点进展。终于知道那个恶魔的来历了！

say:12:1222555007:0.text: Harak is a Hypogean of instincts... I've never heard of his name.
say:12:1222555007:0.source_cn: 哈拉克，本能的恶魔……我没听过这个名字。

say:13:1222555008:0.text: But this doesn't matter! I'll never forgive him! To satisfy his own hunger, he ruined the Dream Isle and put Grandpa Ulmus in danger!
say:13:1222555008:0.source_cn: 不管叫什么，我都不会原谅他！竟然只是为了满足自己的食欲...

say:16:1222555009:0.text: We came here to discuss countermeasures with you. To deal with him, we need to use bait and a strong net.
say:16:1222555009:0.source_cn: 我们这次来就是找你商量对策。对付那家伙，要用“饵”和“网”。

say:18:1222555011:0.text: I have a thought. Tasi, you said Harak headed directly to the Land of Riches when he arrived on the island, right? Isn't that a bit strange?
say:18:1222555011:0.source_cn: 我有个想法。塔西，你说过哈拉克一上岛就直奔流金之地，对...

say:22:1222555012:1.text: Yes, the Land of Riches is hidden beneath the lake, and the island has many living beings. Why would he head straight for the treasure in the cave?
say:22:1222555012:1.source_cn: 对呀，明明流金之地隐蔽在湖下，岛上也有很多活物，他为什...

choice_prompt:23:1222555012.text: Yes, the Land of Riches is hidden beneath the lake, and the island has many living beings. Why would he head straight for the treasure in the cave?
choice_prompt:23:1222555012.source_cn: 对呀，明明藏宝之地隐蔽在湖下，岛上也有很多活物，他为什么会直奔洞里的宝物堆呢？

say:24:1222555013:0.text: Of course. After Tritonus left the sword behind, there were sometimes accidental visitors who drifted onto the island.
say:24:1222555013:0.source_cn: 当然。特勒米琉斯把剑留下之后，偶尔会有人因为意外漂流登岛。

say:25:1222555014:0.text: Grandpa Ulmus was always asleep, and I was so bored, so I went through their minds while they were dreaming and took out the things they desired most.
say:25:1222555014:0.source_cn: 奥曼斯爷爷一直睡着，我自己实在太无聊，就趁流浪者睡觉时...

say:26:1222555015:1.text: Over time, there was more and more.
say:26:1222555015:1.source_cn: 久而久之，就变成那样啦。

say:28:1222555016:0.text: So, all the gold and that ship in a bottle were all created by you?
say:28:1222555016:0.source_cn: 所以，那些金币，还有那艘瓶中船，都是你变出来的？

say:29:1222555017:0.text: Of course, silly human. How could there be such a large and beautiful ship in a bottle in real life?
say:29:1222555017:0.source_cn: 当然啦，傻傻的人类朋友。现实里怎么会有那么大、那么漂亮...

say:31:1222555019:1.text: She still owes me a thank you!

choice_prompt:33:1222555019.text: She still owes me a thank you!

say:34:1222555020:1.text: Desire... the thoughts and wishes of all the people who visited the island!
say:34:1222555020:1.source_cn: ——是欲望，是登岛人的心中所想！

say:35:1222555021:1.text: The Land of Riches was where the most wishes on this island were concentrated. Harak wanted to devour those desires, which is why he headed straight for it!
say:35:1222555021:1.source_cn: 流金之地是这座岛上凝聚了最多愿望的地方，哈拉克想要吞噬...

say:42:1222555024:1.source_cn: 我倒是试过用鳞粉让他睡着。不过他实在太多动了，还没等催...

choice:23:0:1.source_cn: 宝物堆是用造梦魔法变出来的吗？
choice:23:0:1.male: Was the treasure made with magic?
choice:23:0:1.female: Was the treasure made with magic?

choice:9:1:2.source_cn: （隐瞒失败过程，告知调查结果）

say:0:1222559001:0.text: The corner up ahead would be ideal for traps.
say:0:1222559001:0.source_cn: 前面的拐角处也很适合做陷阱。

say:0:1222563001:0.text: It just occurred to me. We definitely need a trap at the deepest point of the Land of Riches.
say:0:1222563001:0.source_cn: 我想到了，流金之地最深处绝对需要一个陷阱！

say:0:1222569001:0.text: Let's find a spot to hide and wait for Harak.
say:0:1222569001:0.source_cn: 我们找个隐蔽的地方躲好，等哈拉克过来吧。

say:3:1222575002:1.text: With your help, indeed I am.
say:3:1222575002:1.source_cn: 哦呵呵，在你们的帮助下，我也该醒来了。

say:4:1222575003:1.text: Magister Merlin, you have my deepest gratitude. You and the sword bearer have fulfilled your duties once again and broken me out of that living nightmare that imprisoned me.
say:4:1222575003:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，梅林。你和持剑的英雄再次践行了使命，驱散了困住...
say:4:1222575003:1.male: Magister Merlin, you have my deepest gratitude. You and the sword bearer have fulfilled your duties once again and broken me out of that living nightmare that imprisoned me.
say:4:1222575003:1.female: Magister Merlin, you have my deepest gratitude. You and the sword bearer have fulfilled your duties once again and broken me out of that living nightmare that imprisoned me.

choice_prompt:5:1222575003.text: Magister Merlin, you have my deepest gratitude. You and the sword bearer have fulfilled your duties once again and broken me out of that living nightmare that imprisoned me.
choice_prompt:5:1222575003.source_cn: 谢谢你，梅林。你和持剑的英雄再次践行了使命，驱散了困住我的梦魇。
choice_prompt:5:1222575003.male: Magister Merlin, you have my deepest gratitude. You and the sword bearer have fulfilled your duties once again and broken me out of that living nightmare that imprisoned me.
choice_prompt:5:1222575003.female: Magister Merlin, you have my deepest gratitude. You and the sword bearer have fulfilled your duties once again and broken me out of that living nightmare that imprisoned me.

say:6:1222575005:0.text: Tasi and I are extremely grateful that you have protected this delicate dream that's been drifting across this beautiful sea for centuries.
say:6:1222575005:0.source_cn: 但我和塔西仍然要向你们致意，感谢你们保护了这处在汪洋中...

say:7:1222575006:1.text: The wishes and dreams of mortals are precious yet fragile.
say:7:1222575006:1.source_cn: 凡人的愿望和梦想很宝贵，也很易碎。

say:8:1222575007:1.text: But it's precisely because of this that they shine like priceless treasures.
say:8:1222575007:1.source_cn: 不过也是因为这样，它们才会像真正的宝物一样闪闪发光。

say:9:1222575008:1.text: Thank you! And Sinbad, we can't forget your help either!
say:9:1222575008:1.source_cn: 谢谢啦——还有你，辛巴达！这次也不能忘了你的功劳！

say:11:1222575009:0.text: Hahahaha... no big deal. You've been calling me a hero all this time anyway.
say:11:1222575009:0.source_cn: 嘿嘿，还好啦。毕竟你一直在称我为英雄。

say:12:1222575010:0.text: For once, I actually feel worthy of the title.
say:12:1222575010:0.source_cn: 至少这次，我觉得自己真正担起了英雄的名号。

say:15:1222575011:0.text: Tasi, with Harak sealed in the bottle now, will you and Ulmus continue to watch over him?
say:15:1222575011:0.source_cn: 塔西，哈拉克现在被封在瓶中，那你和奥曼斯以后还要继续看...

say:16:1222575012:0.text: Well, yes... It won't be as easy-going as before.
say:16:1222575012:0.source_cn: 嗯……是呢！不会像之前那么自由了。

say:17:1222575013:1.text: But rest assured, for me and Grandpa Ulmus, this is just a tiny moment in the vast sea of time.
say:17:1222575013:1.source_cn: 不过放心，对于我和奥曼斯爷爷来说，这只是漫长时间中一段...

say:18:1222575014:1.text: I'll sneak into people's dreams to have some fun whenever I get the chance. Who knows, maybe you'll run into me in your dreams someday!
say:18:1222575014:1.source_cn: 我也会找机会偷溜去别人的梦里玩耍。也许哪一天，你们就又...

say:19:1222575015:0.text: It's time to say farewell, Tasi. They must not halt their journey on our account.
say:19:1222575015:0.source_cn: 该说再见了，塔西。别让他们的步伐为我们而停。

say:20:1222575016:0.text: Ah, alright then, though I'm sad to see you go, every story must have an ending.
say:20:1222575016:0.source_cn: 哎呀哎呀，好吧，虽然不舍得你们，但故事总有完结的时刻。

say:23:1222575017:0.text: So long, my heroes of legend!
say:23:1222575017:0.source_cn: 那么，再会了，撰写传奇的英雄们！

say:24:1222575018:1.text: Grandpa Ulmus and I sincerely wish that all your dreams will come true!
say:24:1222575018:1.source_cn: 我和奥曼斯真诚祝愿，你们所梦的一切，也在现实中梦想成真！

say:26:1222575004:0.text: There is still a long road ahead of you. We are merely a brief and humble stop in your lengthy journey.
say:26:1222575004:0.source_cn: 你还有很长的路要走。我们只是你漫长旅途中的一小片树荫，...
say:26:1222575004:0.male: There is still a long road ahead of you. We are merely a brief and humble stop in your lengthy journey.
say:26:1222575004:0.female: There is still a long road ahead of you. We are merely a brief and humble stop in your lengthy journey.

choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 我的使命是不是还没有结束？

say:0:1222576001:1.text: Okay, next stop: the northern highlands.
say:0:1222576001:1.source_cn: 好，接下来是北面的高地。

say:0:1222577001:1.text: Calibration's complete, trajectory checks out—on to the next cannon.
say:0:1222577001:1.source_cn: 调试结束，弹道检验无误，可以去布置下一门炮了。

narration:1:1222580001:0.text: After sailing for some time, you once again arrive at Dream Isle...
narration:1:1222580001:0.source_cn: 航行了一段时间后，你们再次抵达了藏梦岛……

document:0:80:0.text:
A perfect whole night's sleep is worth more than gold.

Elixir Preparation Steps:
1. Place <style="highlight">violet heartstem</style> into the cauldron.
2. Add crushed <style="highlight">nightshade lotus</style> and spread it evenly.
3. Add the pre-soaked chopped <style="highlight">cobalt berries</style> and stir the contents evenly. Let it sit for thirty minutes.

完美的睡眠即使黄金万贯也难求。

第二步，将碾碎的<style="highlight">幽夜莲</style>加入，均匀铺撒
第三步，将提前浸泡过的<style="highlight">淬蓝果</style>切碎加入，将锅中物搅拌均匀，静置三十分钟后制成。

narration:1:1222513001:0.text: The bed is so comfy. A wave of drowsiness hits you, and you fall asleep...
narration:1:1222513001:0.source_cn: 躺在松软的床上，睡意很快袭来……

say:8:1222513004:0.text: Finally! I've been trying to contact you!
say:8:1222513004:0.male: Finally! I've been trying to contact you!
say:8:1222513004:0.female: Finally! I've been trying to contact you!

say:11:1222513005:0.text: Goodness gracious, do you never sleep? It's been so difficult trying to break through your magic wards and contact you in your dreams.
say:11:1222513005:0.source_cn: 天呀，你从来不睡觉吗？想突破魔法防护，从梦里联系到你，...
say:11:1222513005:0.male: Goodness gracious, do you never sleep? It's been so difficult trying to break through your magic wards and contact you in your dreams.
say:11:1222513005:0.female: Goodness gracious, do you never sleep? It's been so difficult trying to break through your magic wards and contact you in your dreams.

say:12:1222513006:0.text: By the way, your dreams are so boring. No chocolate bunnies or clouds made of sugar! Not even a whiff of a cupcake!
say:12:1222513006:0.source_cn: 你的梦好空旷无趣哦，没有巧克力，没有砂糖做成的云……连...
say:12:1222513006:0.male: By the way, your dreams are so boring. No chocolate bunnies or clouds made of sugar! Not even a whiff of a cupcake!
say:12:1222513006:0.female: By the way, your dreams are so boring. No chocolate bunnies or clouds made of sugar! Not even a whiff of a cupcake!

say:13:1222513007:0.text: Alright, never mind. Let's get down to business.
say:13:1222513007:0.source_cn: 啊，不对不对，我得赶快说正事！
say:13:1222513007:0.male: Alright, never mind. Let's get down to business.
say:13:1222513007:0.female: Alright, never mind. Let's get down to business.

say:14:1222513008:0.text: I don't know how long I can stay, so I'll make this short.
say:14:1222513008:0.source_cn: 不知道还能和你保持多久的联系，我就长话短说啦。
say:14:1222513008:0.male: I don't know how long I can stay, so I'll make this short.
say:14:1222513008:0.female: I don't know how long I can stay, so I'll make this short.

say:15:1222513009:2.text: "Help! <style="highlight">The Dream Isle is about to be destroyed!</style>"
say:15:1222513009:2.male: "Help! <style="highlight">The Dream Isle is about to be destroyed!</style>"
say:15:1222513009:2.female: "Help! <style="highlight">The Dream Isle is about to be destroyed!</style>"

narration:21:12022518:0.text: Hammie, Chippy, and you return to the premium suite at Golden Guest Inn and soon fall asleep.
narration:21:12022518:0.source_cn: 你和漫漫满满在客金旅店的高级客房休息，很快进入梦乡。

say:6:1222517001:1.text: Whoa! It's raining cats and dogs!

say:7:1222517002:0.text: Chippy doesn't remember it ever raining on the Dream Isle! It was always sunny.
say:7:1222517002:0.source_cn: 满满不记得藏梦岛上有过这样的大雨！之前一直都是艳阳高照呀。

say:8:1222517003:0.text: The whole island seems to have changed... I wonder what happened.
say:8:1222517003:0.source_cn: 感觉岛上的氛围完全变了……不会真出事了吧？

say:9:1222517004:0.text: Let's go find <style="highlight">Tasi</style>. She can tell us what's happening on the island.

narration:12:12022521:0.text: The creatures on Dream Isle seem rattled by some terrifying monster.
narration:12:12022521:0.source_cn: 藏梦岛上的生物似乎被什么可怕的东西吓坏了。

say:7:1222520001:0.text: Oh, no... what's happened to the Land of Riches?!
say:7:1222520001:0.source_cn: 天啊……流金之地变得一片狼藉了！

say:8:1222520002:0.text: The mountain of gold... All the treasures... Even that beautiful ship in a bottle! Where did everything go?!
say:8:1222520002:0.source_cn: 那些堆成山的金币，宝物……还有那艘漂亮的瓶中船呢？！

say:9:1222520003:1.text: Let me answer that for you. All the gold and treasure were swallowed up by that miserable Hypogean, and he smashed that ship in a bottle out of spitefulness!
say:9:1222520003:1.source_cn: 我可以回答：金币和收集来的宝物，被那头野蛮的恶魔一口气...

say:10:1222520004:1.text: He also left behind all his Hypofiend buddies on his way out.
say:10:1222520004:1.source_cn: 而且那家伙大闹完，还留下这么多污浊丑陋的魔物眷属！

say:11:1222520005:1.text: You mean he ate all the treasure?
say:11:1222520005:1.source_cn: ……吞了？那么多宝贝？他能吃得下？

say:12:1222520006:1.text: He seems to eat anything and everything.
say:12:1222520006:1.source_cn: 他好像什么都能吃，而且什么都想吃。

say:13:1222520007:1.text: If I hadn't escaped when I did, that thing would've torn my wings off and had me for lunch. His stare is like that of a hungry, savage beast on the hunt.
say:13:1222520007:1.source_cn: 要不是我逃得快，连这双美丽的翅膀都会被那头恶魔扯下来嚼...

say:14:1222520008:1.text: Alright, enough jibber-jabber. Let's get down to work.
say:14:1222520008:1.source_cn: 好，前情提要就到这里吧，接下来该开始干活了！

choice_prompt:17:1222520008.text: Alright, enough jibber-jabber. Let's get down to work.
choice_prompt:17:1222520008.source_cn: 好，前情提要就到这里吧，接下来该开始干活了！

say:18:1222520009:1.text: Well, first, we need to get rid of these foul fiends roaming around. Then, we need to figure out how to restore the idyllic dream Ulmus and I had created before.
say:18:1222520009:1.source_cn: 咱们得一起解决在这四周徘徊的脏东西。之后大家再一起想办...

say:21:1222520010:0.text: No problem, Tasi! Leave it to us!
say:21:1222520010:0.source_cn: 没问题，塔西，交给我们吧！

narration:24:12022523:0.text: You arrive in the Land of Riches and find it in shambles and filled with Hypofiends.
narration:24:12022523:0.source_cn: 你们来到流金之地，发现这里不仅变得一片狼藉，还有魔物游荡。

say:3:1222543001:0.text: Hugin! You're going too fast! Don't be in such a hurry to test your cannons!
say:3:1222543001:0.source_cn: 呼……呼金，你跑得太快了！要试火炮的威力也不能这么着急！

say:4:1222543002:0.text: It's a Hypogean, you know! A real one!
say:4:1222543002:0.source_cn: 那可是恶魔！货真价实的恶魔！

say:5:1222543003:0.text: When facing modern technology and true destructive power, all living things must give way!
say:5:1222543003:0.source_cn: 在绝对的技术和火力面前，所有能呼吸的东西，都应该展示敬意！

say:6:1222543004:0.text: Oh, I've located the target. It's on a hilltop to the west over there. That must be the Hypogean you've all been clamoring about.
say:6:1222543004:0.source_cn: 我已经发现目标了，在西侧的高地上，那就是你们说的恶魔吧。

say:12:1222543005:0.text: He's eaten everything on the Dream Isle, and he's still saying he's hungry!
say:12:1222543005:0.source_cn: 都把藏梦岛啃成这样了，他还在喊饿！

say:15:1222543006:0.text: It feels like this Hypogean is different from the ones we've encountered before. There's no reason behind his actions...
say:15:1222543006:0.source_cn: 感觉这个恶魔和我们之前遇到的不太一样，他仿佛没有理性……

say:16:1222543007:0.text: Whether he's a genius or a fool, as long as he's within the range of my cannons, he's dead!
say:16:1222543007:0.source_cn: 嚯嚯，管他是大学者还是野蛮人，只要在大炮射程内，都不是问题！

say:17:1222543008:0.text: But where he's standing now is too covered. We need to lead him to open terrain so I can shell the scallops out of him!
say:17:1222543008:0.source_cn: 不过他所在的高地有视野遮蔽，得想办法把他引到地势开阔的...

say:26:1222543010:0.text: We can bombard him from close range.

say:29:1222543011:0.text: We can also set up on high ground to the north...
say:29:1222543011:0.source_cn: 除此之外，也可以在北方的高地布设炮台……

say:32:1222543012:0.text: Our current position is also suitable for setting up our cannons.
say:32:1222543012:0.source_cn: 当然，我们现在所处的位置也很适合架设火炮！

say:33:1222543013:0.text: Once the cannons are in place, we can have Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> enchant them. And after this Hyposhark has been lured to the position, he'll taste the dual fury of dwarven craftsmanship and expert magic.
say:33:1222543013:0.male: Once the cannons are in place, we can have Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> enchant them. And after this Hyposhark has been lured to the position, he'll taste the dual fury of dwarven craftsmanship and expert magic.
say:33:1222543013:0.female: Once the cannons are in place, we can have Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> enchant them. And after this Hyposhark has been lured to the position, he'll taste the dual fury of dwarven craftsmanship and expert magic.

choice_prompt:34:1222543013.text: Once the cannons are in place, we can have Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> enchant them. And after this Hyposhark has been lured to the position, he'll taste the dual fury of dwarven craftsmanship and expert magic.
choice_prompt:34:1222543013.source_cn: 布置完后，再由<style=stress><player_name></style>大人附魔。等鲨鱼恶魔被引到合适的位置，就可以让他尝尝矮人工艺和魔法大炮的滋味！
choice_prompt:34:1222543013.male: Once the cannons are in place, we can have Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> enchant them. And after this Hyposhark has been lured to the position, he'll taste the dual fury of dwarven craftsmanship and expert magic.
choice_prompt:34:1222543013.female: Once the cannons are in place, we can have Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> enchant them. And after this Hyposhark has been lured to the position, he'll taste the dual fury of dwarven craftsmanship and expert magic.

say:36:1222543014:0.text: You don't even need to ask. It's me, isn't it?

say:37:1222543015:0.text: Alright, I'll find a way to lure the big fella to where Hugin needs him to be.
say:37:1222543015:0.source_cn: 我会想办法把那家伙引到呼金指示的地点。

say:38:1222543016:0.text: You all just ready the cannons. One continuous barrage, and he's mincemeat.
say:38:1222543016:0.source_cn: 然后等你们一轮齐射——砰！事情就解决了。

say:43:1222543018:0.text: We all fought that monster together, and we lost to him.
say:43:1222543018:0.source_cn: 之前我们一起围攻那头恶魔，都打不过他！

say:44:1222543019:1.text: I'm just acting as bait. I'm not gonna fight him head-on. If things go bad, I'll just run away. You all know that I'm the master of escape.
say:44:1222543019:1.source_cn: 只是当诱饵，不是要正面对决。见势不妙就溜，逃跑的事我最熟。

say:45:1222543020:1.text: Firing adjustments and enchanting cannonballs need manpower. I can't do everything by myself, and I don't know the first thing about enchantment. I'd be lucky enough to recognize the runes.
say:45:1222543020:1.source_cn: 火炮校准和附魔都需要人手，难道让我去附魔？饶了我吧，我...

say:46:1222543021:0.text: And don't worry about Sinbad. Except for that time when he turned himself in at Darkstone Cave, I've never seen him get caught.
say:46:1222543021:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈，除了辛巴达自己主动往黑石洞工头手下凑，我还没见...

say:47:1222543022:1.text: If there was a competition for running away, he'd be in first place.
say:47:1222543022:1.source_cn: 如果有溜号遁逃的资质认证，他绝对是顶级！

choice_prompt:48:1222543022.text: If there was a competition for running away, he'd be in first place.
choice_prompt:48:1222543022.source_cn: 如果有溜号遁逃的资质认证，他绝对是顶级！

say:49:1222543023:1.text: Alright, stop. I don't know if you're complimenting me or making fun of me.
say:49:1222543023:1.source_cn: 停，停，我都不知道你们是在夸我还是在贬低我了。

say:50:1222543024:0.text: Hugin, swear on your life that you're gonna hit this guy. Also, you're gonna be careful and not kill me in the process, right?
say:50:1222543024:0.source_cn: 呼金，你给我用性命担保，一定要小心，一定要保证能精准命...

say:53:1222543027:0.text: Alright, in the name of Hardhead, Whistler, and Shorty, I'll be careful.
say:53:1222543027:0.source_cn: 好吧，以铁头、尖哨和矮地的名义。

choice_prompt:54:1222543027.text: Alright, in the name of Hardhead, Whistler, and Shorty, I'll be careful.
choice_prompt:54:1222543027.source_cn: 好吧，以铁头、尖哨和矮地的名义。

say:55:1222543028:0.text: *Sigh*... My life is in your hands. When you're done, let me know through the communicator, and I'll act accordingly.
say:55:1222543028:0.source_cn: 呼……我这条命就交到你们手上了。完事后用通讯器给我报信...

say:56:1222543029:0.text: Oh, god of the waves, please protect me.
say:56:1222543029:0.source_cn: 风浪与漂泊之神啊，希望一切顺利。

say:59:1222543030:0.text: Let's hurry up and take up our positions.
say:59:1222543030:0.source_cn: 那就赶快按计划各就各位吧，嚯哈哈哈。

say:60:1222543031:0.text: Come, Magister, let's go place the first cannon!
say:60:1222543031:0.source_cn: 来，魔法师大人，第一门炮原地设置正合适！
say:60:1222543031:0.male: Come, Magister, let's go place the first cannon!
say:60:1222543031:0.female: Come, Magister, let's go place the first cannon!

choice:48:0:1.text: I once tied him up, you know.
choice:48:0:1.source_cn: 真荣幸，我曾经把他五花大绑
choice:48:0:1.male: I once tied him up, you know.
choice:48:0:1.female: I once tied him up, you know.

choice:34:0:1.text: So, who will be our bait?
choice:34:0:1.male: So, who will be our bait?
choice:34:0:1.female: So, who will be our bait?

choice:34:1:2.source_cn: 愿意直面恶魔的人，请举手！

narration:63:12022070:0.text: Your current location is also suitable to position a cannon.
narration:63:12022070:0.source_cn: 你们现在所在的地方，也适合假设一架大炮轰击鲨鱼恶魔。

narration:64:12022069:0.text: One cannon is far from enough. You need to set up one more nearby.
narration:64:12022069:0.source_cn: 一架大炮的火力不够，你们还需要在近处假设一架大炮轰击鲨...

narration:65:12022068:0.text: Hugin suggests placing a cannon here to blast the Hyposhark.
narration:65:12022068:0.source_cn: 呼金提议在这里摆放一架大炮轰击鲨鱼恶魔。

narration:66:12022062:0.text: Hugin suggests luring the Hyposhark to an open area to attack it with cannons.
narration:66:12022062:0.source_cn: 呼金提议把鲨鱼恶魔引到地势开阔的地方用大炮轰击。

narration:67:12022061:0.text: You spot the Hyposhark nearby. He has gone berserk because of hunger.
narration:67:12022061:0.source_cn: 你们发现了鲨鱼恶魔，他就在离你们不远的地方，正因为吃不...

say:6:1222547002:0.text: Yes, all my children are ready. They're eager to let loose on this Hypogean!
say:6:1222547002:0.source_cn: 没错，这些年轻的孩子都做好准备了。他们跃跃欲试，随时等...

say:7:1222547003:0.text: It's all up to Sinbad now. Contact him on the merlindabest.
say:7:1222547003:0.source_cn: 该轮到辛巴达那小子干活了，用小梅给他发信号！

choice_prompt:8:1222547003.text: It's all up to Sinbad now. Contact him on the merlindabest.
choice_prompt:8:1222547003.source_cn: 该轮到辛巴达那小子干活了，用小梅给他发信号！

say:9:1222547004:0.text: We don't need to wait for his reply. Right now, he's probably as nervous as a lobster at a seafood buffet.
say:9:1222547004:0.source_cn: 嚯嚯，不用等那小子回信，现在是他神经最紧绷的时候。

say:10:1222547005:0.text: Let's get into position as well, or we won't be able to fire in time. If that happens, then he's really done for.
say:10:1222547005:0.source_cn: 咱们也得赶快就位，不然炮弹没法及时发射，他就真的危险了。

narration:20:12022066:0.text: After Sinbad lures the Hyposhark to the target zone, everyone opens fire at the same time. Surprisingly, not only is the Hyposhark unscathed, but it appears even more agitated.
narration:20:12022066:0.source_cn: 辛巴达引诱鲨鱼恶魔进入了炮轰区域，你和呼金、漫漫满满立...

narration:21:12022065:0.text: After enchanting the cannon, you aimed the barrel at the spot where the Hyposhark would soon appear.
narration:21:12022065:0.source_cn: 你给大炮附魔，并把炮口的方向对准鲨鱼恶魔即将出现的位置。

narration:22:12022065:0.text: After enchanting the cannon, you aimed the barrel at the spot where the Hyposhark would soon appear.
narration:22:12022065:0.source_cn: 你给大炮附魔，并把炮口的方向对准鲨鱼恶魔即将出现的位置。

say:9:1222549002:0.text: Well... it's another retreat for Sir Chippy...
say:9:1222549002:0.source_cn: 满满光荣的骑士生涯中又出现了一次大撤退……！

say:10:1222549003:0.text: We can't do this! You all saw! Even Hugin's cannons couldn't do anything to that beast!
say:10:1222549003:0.source_cn: 没办法，你们也看见了，连呼金的炮都没法对那个野兽造成威胁！

say:11:1222549004:0.text: It's impossible! My children are perfect! They're the latest improved model after the battle with the Immortal. They're supposed to be able to take on any sea creature!
say:11:1222549004:0.source_cn: 不可能……这不可能！那些孩子是我的得意之作，是在不死号...

say:12:1222549005:0.text: My aim was accurate... Everything exploded at the right time... There's no reason why the cannons failed!
say:12:1222549005:0.source_cn: 弹道精确无误……火药爆炸威力得当……他们没有道理失败！

choice_prompt:13:1222549005.text: My aim was accurate... Everything exploded at the right time... There's no reason why the cannons failed!
choice_prompt:13:1222549005.source_cn: 弹道精确无误……火药爆炸威力得当……他们没有道理失败！

say:16:1222549006:0.text: Do we really need the power of the gods to do this...?
say:16:1222549006:0.source_cn: 难道只能靠神明的力量……

say:17:1222549007:0.text: Don't look at me! I don't know how to fight him with a compass.
say:17:1222549007:0.source_cn: 别看我，我真不知道该怎么用罗盘打败他！

say:18:1222549008:1.text: I tried it in battle just now. Even when I held it out in front of him, nothing happened. When he used his tail, the compass almost fell out of my hand.
say:18:1222549008:1.source_cn: 刚才战斗里试过了，就算在攻击的间隙举到他面前也毫无反应...

say:21:1222549009:0.text: Hugin, can you think of anything?
say:21:1222549009:0.source_cn: 呼金，你还有其他办法吗？

say:22:1222549010:0.text: Is it his muscle density? Maybe some magical component? Or is it some rule or principle I don't know about...?
say:22:1222549010:0.source_cn: ……是他的肌肉结构特别强韧？魔法？还是有我不知道的工程...

say:23:1222549011:0.text: I have to re-modify my cannons... or a new weapon... I need more powerful components...
say:23:1222549011:0.source_cn: 我得……重新针对他进行武器改造……要找新材料，更具威力...

say:24:1222549012:0.text: No! The island will be devoured by the time you finish your new weapon!
say:24:1222549012:0.source_cn: 不行不行，等你完成“伟大的改造”，整座岛都要被啃光了！

say:25:1222549013:0.text: I don't believe it! There's nothing my creations can't destroy!
say:25:1222549013:0.source_cn: 我不服气！没有我的造物赢不了的东西！

choice_prompt:26:1222549013.text: I don't believe it! There's nothing my creations can't destroy!
choice_prompt:26:1222549013.source_cn: 我不服气！没有我的造物赢不了的东西！

say:30:1222549014:0.text: Now is not the time to be rash. If we blindly rush forward, we're just going to hurt ourselves.
say:30:1222549014:0.source_cn: 嗯，不能再轻举妄动了，毫无头绪地冲上去只会让我们自己受伤。

say:31:1222549015:0.text: I hate to say it, but we have no clue on how to deal with this Hyposhark.
say:31:1222549015:0.source_cn: 虽然很不想这么说，但现在我们没有应对鲨鱼恶魔的计策。

say:32:1222549016:0.text: Let's go back to Rustport first and see if Sonja found any information about this Hypogean. Then, it'll be easier to come up with a plan.
say:32:1222549016:0.source_cn: 还是先回锈锚港，看索尼娅他们有没有调查到恶魔的情报，然...

say:33:1222549017:1.text: Hugin, tell Sonja that if she has any intel on this monster, she can find us at the <style="highlight">Golden Guest Inn</style>.
say:33:1222549017:1.source_cn: 呼金，告诉索尼娅他们，要是找到有关那个恶魔的信息，就去...

choice:26:0:1.text: I can't think of anything right now.
choice:26:0:1.source_cn: 我也暂时想不到别的办法
choice:26:0:1.male: I can't think of anything right now.
choice:26:0:1.female: I can't think of anything right now.

choice:26:1:2.text: I wonder if the Whispers have found any intel.
choice:26:1:2.source_cn: 不知道血薇帮有没有调查结果
choice:26:1:2.male: I wonder if the Whispers have found any intel.
choice:26:1:2.female: I wonder if the Whispers have found any intel.

choice:13:1:2.text: That's why we ran away before...
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 所以我们之前掉头就跑……
choice:13:1:2.male: That's why we ran away before...
choice:13:1:2.female: That's why we ran away before...

choice:13:2:3.text: I've never run away so much in my life.
choice:13:2:3.source_cn: 我一生的逃跑次数都用在这里了
choice:13:2:3.male: I've never run away so much in my life.
choice:13:2:3.female: I've never run away so much in my life.

narration:38:12022067:0.text: The five of you make a hard-fought escape from the Hyposhark, feeling frustrated by the failed ambush.
narration:38:12022067:0.source_cn: 你们五人好不容易逃离了鲨鱼恶魔，大家都对刚才那场失败的...

say:2:1222551001:0.text: Ladies and gentlemen, I wholeheartedly recommend—
say:2:1222551001:0.source_cn: 先生小姐们，我向你们倾情推荐——

say:3:1222551002:0.text: Anything will do. We just need a moment alone.
say:3:1222551002:0.source_cn: 随便什么都行，让我们单独聊会儿。

say:4:1222551003:0.text: Ah, I almost forgot. Bols is a friend of mine, and the man across from me is the hero who liberated Rustport, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Got that? Don't try anything funny with the bill.
say:4:1222551003:0.source_cn: 啊，对了。波尔斯是我兄弟，我对面这位是解放了锈锚港的<...
say:4:1222551003:0.male: Ah, I almost forgot. Bols is a friend of mine, and the man across from me is the hero who liberated Rustport, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Got that? Don't try anything funny with the bill.
say:4:1222551003:0.female: Ah, I almost forgot. Bols is a friend of mine, and the lady across from me is the hero who liberated Rustport, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Got that? Don't try anything funny with the bill.

say:12:1222551006:0.text: ... What's with all the gloomy faces? Haven't you ever lost before?
say:12:1222551006:0.source_cn: ……你们怎么这副表情？难道之前从来没输过？

say:13:1222551007:0.source_cn: 我们之前逃走过，也失败过……

say:14:1222551008:0.text: But this time, it was twice in a row! Even with the cannons helping us, it was a total disaster!
say:14:1222551008:0.source_cn: 但连续两次正面对决，甚至连重武器都用上了，却输得这么彻底！

say:15:1222551009:0.text: What's the deal with that Hyposhark?
say:15:1222551009:0.source_cn: 那个鲨鱼恶魔到底是怎么回事？

say:16:1222551010:0.text: Some Hypogeans are deceitful by nature, while others abide by certain principles… However, you can usually talk to all of them, which in turn allows you to assess certain characteristics and weaknesses.
say:16:1222551010:0.source_cn: 有的恶魔狡诈成性，也有恶魔恪守某种偏执的规则……但无论...

choice_prompt:17:1222551010.text: Some Hypogeans are deceitful by nature, while others abide by certain principles… However, you can usually talk to all of them, which in turn allows you to assess certain characteristics and weaknesses.
choice_prompt:17:1222551010.source_cn: 有的恶魔狡诈成性，也有恶魔恪守某种偏执的规则……但无论如何，至少还能和对方沟通，就有分析性格和弱点的可能。

say:18:1222551011:1.text: Yes, but he's also way too powerful!
say:18:1222551011:1.source_cn: 相对地，他也强悍过头了！

say:19:1222551012:0.text: What a headache, if only that thing was just an ordinary shark.
say:19:1222551012:0.source_cn: 真头疼，那家伙要是条普通的鲨鱼就好了！

say:27:1222551013:0.text: Hey, are you all going shark hunting or something?

say:29:1222551015:1.text: One of the staff said special guests had arrived, so I decided to take a look and overheard you talking about fishing.
say:29:1222551015:1.source_cn: 店伙计说贵客来了，老子就来瞧瞧，正好听到你们在聊捕鱼。

say:30:1222551016:1.text: Ha! You all look so troubled. Come on, catching a shark isn't that hard.
say:30:1222551016:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，瞧你们那头疼的样子，要抓鲨鱼还不简单？

choice_prompt:31:1222551016.text: Ha! You all look so troubled. Come on, catching a shark isn't that hard.
choice_prompt:31:1222551016.source_cn: 哈哈哈，瞧你们那头疼的样子，要抓鲨鱼还不简单？

say:33:1222551017:0.text: Before I took over this crummy inn, I was working the seas. See these scars on my left hand? Got them from a grumpy tiger shark.
say:33:1222551017:0.source_cn: 老子接手这破旅店之前在海上混过。瞧见我左手上这几道伤疤...

say:34:1222551018:1.text: If Rustport hadn't been in lockdown earlier, I'd have shut down this lousy inn and headed back to open waters.
say:34:1222551018:1.source_cn: 要不是之前锈锚港不让出航，老子早关了这破店，接着去海上...

say:35:1222551019:0.text: There's a shark that we just can't take down...
say:35:1222551019:0.source_cn: 但我们无论如何也打不过那条鲨鱼……

say:36:1222551020:1.text: You really need this many people for one shark?
say:36:1222551020:1.source_cn: “你们”？对付一条鱼，要你们这么多人？

say:37:1222551021:0.text: Uh, this shark is special... really special!
say:37:1222551021:0.source_cn: 呃，那条鲨鱼很特殊……非常特殊！

say:38:1222551022:0.text: Long story short, facing it head-on doesn't work.
say:38:1222551022:0.source_cn: 总之，正面对抗的法子行不通。

say:39:1222551023:0.text: So it's some sort of shark king, eh? Well, nothing's impossible.
say:39:1222551023:0.source_cn: 遇上鱼王了？那也不是没招。

say:41:1222551024:1.text: Drop the right kind of bait and give it whatever it craves.
say:41:1222551024:1.source_cn: 下对应的活饵，它喜欢吃什么，就给它什么。

say:42:1222551025:1.text: Lay bait in different spots and set a tough net at the final location. Once the shark gets a taste, it'll find itself trapped.
say:42:1222551025:1.source_cn: 多在几个地方布饵，等到最后一处再下坚韧的钢丝网线。等鲨...

say:43:1222551026:1.text: The harder it fights, the more the net tightens, until finally, it'll be ready for the taking.
say:43:1222551026:1.source_cn: 它越挣扎，网就缠得越紧，最后就是手到擒来的丰收时刻。

say:46:1222551027:1.text: Hmm, fishing expertise... not sure if it'll be useful here...
say:46:1222551027:1.source_cn: 唔，捕鱼的学问，不知道能不能派上用场……

say:47:1222551028:1.text: Don't doubt my skills. When I was hanging my prizes on Rustport's walls, you little furballs were probably furbabies.
say:47:1222551028:1.source_cn: 怀疑老子的技术？老子把猎物挂上锈锚港城墙时，你们这几个...

say:50:1222551029:1.text: B-Boss, sir! Someone's looking for you!

say:51:1222551030:0.text: Hey, I'm reminiscing here! I think someone deserves a good thrashing!
say:51:1222551030:0.source_cn: 喂，打断老子回忆荣耀的往昔，你皮痒了吧！

choice_prompt:56:1222551030.text: Hey, I'm reminiscing here! I think someone deserves a good thrashing!
choice_prompt:56:1222551030.source_cn: 喂，打断老子回忆荣耀的往昔，你皮痒了吧！

say:57:1222551031:0.text: Sinbad, are you familiar with what Bols said? Catching sharks, that is.
say:57:1222551031:0.source_cn: 辛巴达，刚才波尔斯说的方法你听说过吗？

say:58:1222551032:0.text: Using bait and a strong net... yeah, I get the gist of it.
say:58:1222551032:0.source_cn: 下饵，布网……这我倒是大概知道。

say:59:1222551033:1.text: Bols was talking about catching regular sharks, but we're dealing with a Hypogean here. It's completely different.
say:59:1222551033:1.source_cn: 波尔斯说的是捕获普通鲨鱼的方法，但我们要对付的是恶魔，...

say:60:1222551034:1.text: Based on past battles, even if we can lure him in, we won't be able to subdue him...
say:60:1222551034:1.source_cn: 以之前战斗的经验，就算能引诱他上钩，也没有办法制服他……

say:63:1222551035:0.text: Are you an idiot? This is Lucca of the Carmine Whispers! You should've told me immediately when he came in!
say:63:1222551035:0.source_cn: ——没长眼睛吗，这是血薇帮的二当家！来了就该立刻告诉我！

say:65:1222551037:1.text: Hey, Lucca. Don't mind him. He's new. He's still learning the ropes. <style="stress"><player_name></style> and the team are inside.
say:65:1222551037:1.source_cn: 二当家，这是新收的小弟，不懂事。<style=stre...
say:65:1222551037:1.male: Hey, Lucca. Don't mind him. He's new. He's still learning the ropes. <style="stress"><player_name></style> and the team are inside.
say:65:1222551037:1.female: Hey, Lucca. Don't mind him. He's new. He's still learning the ropes. <style="stress"><player_name></style> and the team are inside.

choice:56:1:2.source_cn: 还是说回恶魔的话题吧

choice:31:0:1.source_cn: 我们说的可不是普通的鲨鱼……

narration:70:12022072:0.text: As you return to Golden Guest Inn, still feeling dejected, Bols approaches you.
narration:70:12022072:0.source_cn: 你们回到了客金旅店，还没走出刚才失败的沮丧时，波尔斯朝...

choice:17:0:1.text: This one just yells for food.
choice:17:0:1.male: This one just yells for food.
choice:17:0:1.female: This one just yells for food.

choice:17:1:2.text: But this one is like a wild beast.
choice:17:1:2.source_cn: 那家伙简直像纯粹的野兽
choice:17:1:2.male: But this one is like a wild beast.
choice:17:1:2.female: But this one is like a wild beast.

say:3:1222556001:0.text: This place is relatively open and has a good vantage point. It seems like a great spot to lure Harak!
say:3:1222556001:0.source_cn: 这地方相对空旷，视野也好。感觉是诱哈拉克上钩的好地方！

say:4:1222556002:0.text: Excellent, it's time for me to take the stage.
say:4:1222556002:0.source_cn: 很好很好，这时候就轮到我登场了。

say:5:1222556003:0.text: Alright, brave heroes! Who will step forward to reveal their true selves?
say:5:1222556003:0.source_cn: 好了，勇敢的英雄们！展出的舞台已经备好，谁身先士卒展现...

say:6:1222556004:0.text: Chippy has nothing to hide! Chippy will go first!
say:6:1222556004:0.source_cn: 满满，让满满来吧，满满没什么要隐瞒的！

say:7:1222556005:0.text: I'm ready too. To defeat Harak, I'm willing to bare my heart.
say:7:1222556005:0.source_cn: 我也是。为了击败哈拉克，我愿意展示心中的愿望。

say:8:1222556006:1.text: Well then, close your eyes, and I'll cast my fairy magic.
say:8:1222556006:1.source_cn: 那——么，闭上眼睛，让我来施展妖精的魔法吧！

cinematic_dialogue:12:1222557001:.text: Hamsters of the Heroic Order, fall in line!

say:16:1222556007:0.text: Wow, I've never seen so many hamsters in all my life.
say:16:1222556007:0.source_cn: 哇哦，我这辈子还没见过这么多仓鼠呢。

say:17:1222556008:0.text: That's Chippy, the leader of the Heroic Order! Chippy is training new recruits!
say:17:1222556008:0.source_cn: ——那是仓鼠骑士团团长满满！我在训练指挥新人！

say:20:1222556009:0.text: I'm casting spells, and they're all spells I've created myself!
say:20:1222556009:0.source_cn: 我在用魔法……而且是原创的魔法！

say:21:1222556010:0.text: I'm alongside <style="stress"><player_name></style> and have turned into the best familiar...
say:21:1222556010:0.male: I'm alongside <style="stress"><player_name></style> and have turned into the best familiar...
say:21:1222556010:0.female: I'm alongside <style="stress"><player_name></style> and have turned into the best familiar...

say:22:1222556011:0.text: One seeks to be a true and distinguished knight, while the other desires to become a mage capable of standing beside Merlin.
say:22:1222556011:0.source_cn: 一个想要成为名副其实的杰出骑士，另一个想要成长为能和梅...
say:22:1222556011:0.male: One seeks to be a true and distinguished knight, while the other desires to become a mage capable of standing beside Merlin.
say:22:1222556011:0.female: One seeks to be a true and distinguished knight, while the other desires to become a mage capable of standing beside Merlin.

say:24:1222556013:0.text: They aren't overly grand or spectacular wishes, but two very lovely dreams!
